title: Herb Crusted Baked Cod with Pasta
description: A light and flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring a hearty herb crust on cod paired with a simple pasta side dish.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together herbal breadcrumbs, garlic, and parsley.
Season cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Drizzle olive oil over cod and coat with breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place cod on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water and then drain the pasta.
Add reserved pasta water to the pasta and toss with grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve cod with pasta and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
